Captain Ahab has become convinced that the elusive whale Moby Dick is harboring a stowaway named Ishmael, who somehow keeps escaping every encounter. The Pequod's crew records daily observations in hopes of predicting how far Moby Dick travels while searching for Ishmael.

As the ship's statistician, your task is to develop regression models that explain whale movement.

The file provided for this assignment contains 60 days of observations with the following variables:

Variable |	Description
--- | ---
distance	| Distance traveled by Moby Dick that day (nautical miles)
sightings	| Number of reported Ishmael sightings
fog	| Average fog density index (0-10)
day	| Day of voyage

```{r}
observations <- read.csv("https://")
```
